results.title: Burkina Faso ta bayar da sammacin kamo wasu mutane 20 da ke wajen ƙasar
results.content: Ƙasar Burkina Faso ta bayar da sammacin kamawa tare da miƙa wa hukumomi wasu mutane 20, ciki har da ƴan jarida da ke gudun hijira, masu fafutuka, tsohon minista da kuma tsoffin jami'an soji.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Yaran jihar Borno da aka yi garkuwa da su, sun cika kwanaki 213 ba tare da jin ɗuriyarsu ba
results.content: Yayin yaƙin neman zaɓe ke ƙara kankama a Najeriya, iyalan yaran da aka sace a jihohin Borno da Neja na ci gaba da jiran tsammanin ganin dawowar yaransu.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Gwamnatin Bauchi ta sauke sarkin Lame daga kujerarsa
results.content: Gwamnatin jihar Bauchi da ke arewacin Najeriya ta sanar kwance rawanin sarkin Lame dake ƙaramar hukumar Toro, sakamakon zarginsa da aikata laifuka da kuma take dokokin aiki.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Tinubu ya umurci hukumomin tsaro da su dakile ayyukan 'ƴan daban siyasa
results.content: Shugaba Bola Tinubu ya umurci hukumomin tsaro da su dakile ayyukan ƴan daba na siyasa kafin babban zaɓen 2027. Tinubu ya kuma gargadi ƴan siyasa da magoya bayansu game da tashin hankali, yana mai cewa gwamnatinsa ba za ta lamunci ayyukan da za su iya kawo cikas ga zaman lafiya a lokacin yakin neman zaɓe ba.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Kotun musamman ta jaddada hukuncin ƙwace kadarorin Emefiele
results.content: Wata kotun tafi da gidanka a jihar Legas, da ke sauraron shari'o'in manyan laifukan da suka haɗa da almundahanar kuɗaɗe da cin hanci da rashawa, ta jaddada hukuncin Kotun Ƙolin Najeriya na ƙwace kadarorin guda bakwai, da kuma dala miliyan 2,gami da wasu takardun hannun jari masu alaƙa da tsohon gwamnan babban bankin Najeriya CBN, Godwin Emefiele.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: PDP ta yi marhaba da hukuncin kotun na mayar da Adebutu a jerin ƴan takara a jihar Ogun
results.content: PDP ta yi marhaba da hukuncin da Babbar Kotun na mayar da Adebutu a matsayin dan takararta a jihar Ogun na shekarar 2027. A cikin wata sanarwa da kakakin jam'iyyar, Jungudo Mohammed, ya fitar a jiya Juma'a, jam'iyyar ta yi kira ga INEC da ta bi umarnin kotun nan take.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Kotun Philippines ta ba da umarnin kama wani mai wa'azi da Amurka ke nema
results.content: Kotun Philippines ta ba da umarnin kama wani mai wa'azi da Amurka ke nema ruwa a jalo bisa zargin safarar yara kanana, matakin da zai kai ga yiwuwar mika shi ga Amurka, sanarwa daga hukumomin na Philippines.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Rundunar sojin Mali ta kashe mayakan JNIM da suka farma wasu kauyuka
results.content: Rundunar sojin Mali ta sanar da kashe mayakan jihadi da suka farma wasu kauyuka da suka hada da Kadiana, yankin Bougouni, da kuma Boulkessi, yankin Douentza ta hanyar kai musu kai hari ta sama a jiya Juma'a.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Faɗan ɓangarorin ƴan ta'adda 2 a Burkina Faso ya kashe mutane fiye da 400- Rahoto
results.content: Wani rahoto da ƙungiyar ACLED mai sanya idanu a yankunan da ake fama da rikice-rikice ta fitar, ya bayyana yadda aka samu wani rikici tsakanin ɓangarorin ƴan ta’adda biyu dukkaninsu masu iƙirarin jihadi akan iyakar Burkina Faso da Mali, rikicin da ya kashe adadi mai yawa na ɓatagarin, wanda ƙungiyar ke cewa shi ne mafi muni da aka taɓa gani tsakanin ƴanta’addan na yankin Sahel.

results.title: Bitar muhimman abubuwan da suka faru a wannan mako daga nan Rfi
results.content: A Najeriya,jam’iyyar APC mai mulki ta baiwa jami’an tsaro umarnin bincika da hukunta ƴan dabar da suka tarwatsa taron magoya bayan ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa na jam’iyyar NDC, Peter Obi a jihar Legas jiya alhamis.

results.title: INEC a Najeriya ta cire sunayen bogi, sama da milyan 1 da dubu 600
results.content: A cikin shirin dandalin siyasa na yau, za mu ji cewa a yayin da ake cigaba da shirye-shiryen babban zaɓen shekarar 2027, hukumar zaɓe mai zaman kanta ta ƙasa, INEC, ta bayyana cewa ta cire sunayen bogi, sama da miliyan 1 da dubu 600 daga rajistar masu zaɓe, bayan gano kura-kurai da wasu jami’anta suka tafka-------------

results.title: APC ta umarci jami'an tsaro su hukunta masu hannu a hari kan ƴan adawa
results.content: Jam’iyyar APC mai mulkin Najeriya ta bai wa jami’an tsaro umarnin bincika da hukunta ƴan dabar da suka tarwatsa taron magoya bayan ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa na jam’iyyar NDC, Peter Obi a jihar Legas jiya alhamis.

results.title: Tsadar makamashi ta tilasta kulle kashi 40 na gidajen burodi a Najeriya- PBAN
results.content: Ƙungiyar masu gidajen burodi a Najeriya ta koka da yadda tsadar makamashi ke barazana ga ayyukan mambobinta, bayan da ta ce yanzu haka kashi 40 na gidajen burodin da ke faɗin ƙasar sun dakatar da ayyukansu.

results.title: Malam Umar Saleh kan katsewar sadarwar Microsoft a ƙasashe da dama
results.content: Yau harkokin sadarwar kamfanin Microsoft a fadin duniya ya katse sakamakon matsalolin da na'urorin kamfanin suka samu, abinda ya kai ga katsewar sadarwa a faɗin duniya.

results.title: Ƴan takara 4 dake neman kujerar shugabancin hukumar OIF ta ƙasashe rainon Faransa
results.content: Zuwa yanzu mutane huɗu ne ke takarar neman kujerar shugaban hukumar kula da ƙungiyar ƙasashe rainon Faransa wato OIF, yayinda ake jiran gudanar da zaɓe a ranar Litinin mai zuwa a birnin Phnom Penh, na ƙasar Cambodia.

results.title: Ƴan Ghana sun yi maraba da sanya hotunan fitattun mutane a sabbin takardun kuɗi
results.content: Ghana ta sauya takardun kuɗinta ta hanyar samar da ƙanana masu nagarta, waɗanda ta inganta tsare-tsaren da za su basu kariya daga samar da jabunsu, a dai-dai lokacin da take sabunta kuɗaɗen ta.

results.title: Yadda ma'aikata basa morar tsarin biyan alawus ɗin wuce lokacin aiki a Najeriya
results.content: A shekarun baya ma'aikatan gwamnati da kamfanoni kan karɓi wasu kuɗaɗe wanda ƙari ne a kan albashin su, idan sun gudanar da aikin da ya zarce awannin da aka ware musu da ake kira 'overtime'.
